note: Set A binds most values plausibly to the correct beam details and keeps useful conditions (circular opening ø 3", 2" top/bottom edge offsets, 6" opening height, inter-opening spacings), though it twice calls the 2" edge distance a "height" and twice calls the 6" opening height a "width", and treats a 3'-0"/5'-0" segment dimension as an opening/beam length. Set B adds the correct 1/2" edge-radius note and the W10X15 section for D5, but it invents values not on the sheet (a 20" spacing summed from two 10" segments and a 3'-0"+3'-7"+5'-0"+5'-0" beam length whose quote is only the detail title), and it misbinds several dimensions to the wrong detail (4'-2" to B1, W10X15 to "Grid 3 / B1", 3'-7" to Grid 5) plus vague claims like "remaining length 3'" and "distance to grid line C". Overall A has fewer unsupported or misbound claims while covering the key opening dimensions.
